svg.title: KRO example: CPU allocation on node-c
svg.desc: Original report CPU curves for five pods on node-c. Peak effective demand is 7.917 of 8 cores. Recommended requests total 7.392 cores and limits total 11 cores, within the 12-core limit overcommit boundary.
svg.text: Synthetic example · 5 placed pods · 168 hourly observations · 1–7 Aug 2026 (UTC)
